# Egress allow-list for the issues triage bot's agent job.
#
# The propose job of lfreleng-actions/github-issues-triage-bot runs a
# read-only agent on a packet of issue text. This list is what that
# one job may reach under 'egress-policy: block'. The bot's other
# jobs keep the organisation list
# (../lfreleng-actions/allow_list.txt).
#
# The session reads an offline packet, so the job needs GitHub, the
# npm registry for the pinned Copilot CLI, and the model. Do not add
# other hosts here.
#
# Evidence: harden-runner audit records of the seven agent sessions
# that ran in audit mode, 6 October to 13 November 2026. Every one
# reached these hosts and no other.
#
# Load it by explicit path with harden-runner-block-action:
#
#   - uses: lfreleng-actions/harden-runner-block-action@<sha>  # <version>
#     with:
#       config: 'lfreleng-actions//.github/harden-runner/bots/issues_triage.txt@<.github commit sha>'
#
# This file is not named 'allow_list.txt' on purpose; see
# ../README.md for why a second file of that name breaks forks.
#
# Format: one host[:port] entry per line, sorted alphabetically
# (LC_ALL=C), with a '# comment' directly above each entry.

# GitHub hosted-runner control plane (hosted-compute orchestrator and
# watchdog), reached by the runner itself after the job's steps.
*.githubapp.com:443

# Copilot model API and the CLI's telemetry. The host differs by
# credential: api.enterprise.githubcopilot.com and
# telemetry.enterprise.githubcopilot.com for a personal token,
# api.githubcopilot.com for the job's own token.
*.githubcopilot.com:443

# GitHub REST API, reached by the Copilot CLI itself.
api.github.com:443

# Copilot CLI metrics endpoint.
cafe.github.com:443

# GitHub over HTTPS: checkout of the prompt assets.
github.com:443

# npm registry: the job installs the pinned Copilot CLI from its
# lockfile.
registry.npmjs.org:443
